name: Isonoe

shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at about 6.1 km, estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for Isonoe (22.894 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 15.2 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured.

introduction: Isonoe is a small, distant irregular moon of Jupiter, only a few kilometres across. Its size is estimated from its brightness.
card: A small, distant irregular moon of Jupiter.
datasetSummary: A sphere about 6.1 km across, estimated from brightness with an assumed 4% albedo.
